bullet: Busy while a round is in flight (`F11.goal-busy`).
script:
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$H" --name f11-h --duration 300
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal" --json '{"objective": "QA_F11 busy objective"}' --expect 200 --save F11.goal-busy/start
control-agent-server conversation wait "$H" --until running --timeout 30
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal" --json '{"objective": "QA_F11 second objective", "max_iterations": 1}' --expect 409 --check detail eq 'Conversation run or goal loop already running.' --save F11.goal-busy/second-goal
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal/resume" --expect 409 --check detail eq 'Conversation run or goal loop already running.' --save F11.goal-busy/resume
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/run" --expect 409 --check detail eq 'Conversation already running. Wait for completion or pause first.' --save F11.goal-busy/run
control-agent-server conversation events "$H" --key goal --contains '"active": true, "status": "running", "iteration": 0, "max_iterations": 10, "objective": "QA_F11 busy objective"' --expect-count 1
control-agent-server conversation events "$H" --key goal --expect-count 1 --save F11.goal-busy/goal-events
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f11-hang --expect-min 1 --expect-max 1
